newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine communist deputy found dead - Interfax.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine communist deputy found dead - Interfax.

text.p: A communist parliamentarian was found dead at home in the Ukrainian capital on Sunday, and the interior minister had departed for the scene, Interfax-Ukraine news agency quoted city police as saying.
Nikolai Zavarzyn, born in 1944, was a member of parliament's defence and security commission from a group called "Communists for social justice and people's power," it said.
There was no immediate evidence that Zavarzyn had died a violent death or of a break-in at his Kiev apartment.
But Interior Minister Yuri Kravchenko and two of his deputies had gone to Zavarzyn's home, where medical experts were carrying out an investigation, the news agency said.
